title: Deep V-Neck Lace Cap Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elegant and easy to wear, this evening dress flatters the neckline and collarbone with its soft V-neck. The fitted bodice helps define the waist, while the high low skirt moves beautifully and gives the legs a graceful finish. A lovely choice for weddings, cocktail parties, evening receptions, and other special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
